# Liel Wainberg

> First-party portfolio of Liel Wainberg, a Jerusalem-based developer and UX/UI designer who builds software, systems, applications, digital products, e-commerce, integrations, and automation. The same person also works in canine behavior and hospitality through LW.LIQUID.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Profile, capabilities, selected projects, canine work, hospitality work, and direct contact.
- [Software and digital products](/web): Liel's development, UX/UI, architecture, and delivery work.
- [Canine behavior](/dogs): Liel's approach to dog training and behavior.
- [LW.LIQUID](/bar): Liel's mixology, private hosting, and bar operations work.
